documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Annual Sustainability Report For The Financial Year 2025-26

analysis.summary: Acutaas Chemicals Limited reported strong financial results for Q2 FY27, driven by robust performance in the Advanced Pharmaceutical Intermediate and CDMO segments. Management revised its full-year revenue growth guidance to around 30% and raised the EBITDA margin guidance to 38%-40% for FY27. The company commenced commercial revenues in its Battery Chemicals business and inaugurated its semiconductor chemicals plant in South Korea ahead of schedule. Furthermore, management updated its CDMO revenue target to achieve Rs. 2,000 crores by FY 2030.

guidance.claim: Management revised the revenue growth guidance for the current year from 25% to around 30%.
guidance.quote: Before I conclude, I would also like to revise our revenue growth guidance for current year from 25% to around 30%.

guidance.claim: Management raised the EBITDA margin guidance to between the 38%-40% range for FY '27.
guidance.quote: We are also raising our EBITDA margin guidance between 38%-40% range for FY '27.

guidance.claim: Management targets achieving Rs. 2,000 crore CDMO revenue by FY 2030.
guidance.quote: It means from Rs. 1,000 crores, the new target we had set is Rs. 2,000 crore by FY 2030.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve the Rs. 1,000 crores CDMO revenue target in FY '27, one year ahead of schedule.
guidance.quote: Based on the current orders of existing as well as new CDMO contracts, we now believe we will achieve this target one year ahead of schedule. It means in FY '27, we will be achieving this Rs. 1,000 crores.

guidance.claim: The management remains confident of delivering 25% revenue growth for the full year with stable margins.
guidance.quote: To conclude, we have started the new financial year on a strong note and I remain confident of delivering 25% revenue growth for the full year with stable margins.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment for the Pharmaceutical Intermediate business remains robust.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand environment remains robust and whatever cost pressures we face due to geopolitical issues, we have been able to pass them on successfully.

demand_outlook.claim: In the battery chemicals industry, demand continues to exceed supply.
demand_outlook.quote: From industry point of view, demand continues to exceed supply.

demand_outlook.claim: BFC is experiencing strong order demand from its U.S. customers along with new orders from Korean and Japanese customers.
demand_outlook.quote: BFC is seeing strong order demand from its U.S. customers, as well as we have started receiving orders from Korean and Japanese customers.

demand_outlook.claim: The BFC business was impacted during the quarter due to a change in ownership of the US customer.
demand_outlook.quote: Due to change in ownership of the US customer

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment for the company's products remains strong as reflected in the quarter's results.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment for our products remains strong as reflected in the quarter's results.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for battery chemicals remains exceptionally strong, driven by tight global supply.
demand_outlook.quote: Within Specialty Chemicals, demand for battery chemicals remain exceptionally strong. I'm pleased to share that we have successfully completed the trial run of our battery chemicals plant and started commercial supply. Demand here is unprecedented, driven by tight global supply and we, therefore, expect a rapid ramp-up over the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: Ongoing customer engagement reinforces the conviction that memory chip demand will remain strong.
demand_outlook.quote: Our ongoing engagement with customers reinforces our conviction that memory chip demand will remain strong.

demand_outlook.claim: The core Pharmaceutical Intermediates business delivered robust growth driven by top products and new products gaining volume traction.
demand_outlook.quote: While CDMO grew strongly year-on-year as we expected, the core Pharmaceutical Intermediates business also delivered a robust growth. This was driven by our top products as well as by a couple of new products that are gaining volume traction.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capital expenditure for H1 FY '27 was Rs. 1,239 million.
capex_expansion.quote: CAPEX for H1 FY '27 was Rs. 1,239 million.

capex_expansion.claim: Management believes the total capex for the full year would be around Rs. 3,000 million.
capex_expansion.quote: Furthermore, for the full year, we believe our total CAPEX would be around Rs. 3,000 million.

capex_expansion.claim: The company inaugurated its plant in South Korea ahead of schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: I am happy to say that we have inaugurated our plant in South Korea ahead of schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for Q1 FY27 stood at INR56 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Now turning to the capital expenditures. capex for Q1 FY '27 stood at INR56 crores, out of which INR15 crores were at the Indichem site, remaining INR41 crores in ACL site, which is primarily diverted towards the battery chemical project at the Jhaghadia site. And then pilot plant at our Sachin site and maintenance capex.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for the quarter was Rs. 2,715 million, reflecting a 59% increase year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit for the quarter was Rs. 2,715 million reflecting 59% increase compared to the same period last year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by 637 basis points year-on-year to 62.1%.
margins_costs.quote: The gross margin expanded by 637 basis point Y-o-Y to 62.1%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter reached Rs. 1,760 million, up 84.6% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was Rs. 1,760 million up 84.6% Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 40.3%, up 914 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins were at 40.3% up 914 basis point Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for the quarter was Rs. 1,231 million, up 71.4% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: PAT for the quarter was Rs. 1,231 million up 71.4% Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for the quarter was INR190.9 crores, reflecting a 73% increase compared to the same period last year.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit for the quarter was INR190.9 crores, reflecting a 73% increase compared to the same period last year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR113.1 crores, which represents more than twofold increase compared to the EBITDA of the same period last year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR113.1 crores, which represents more than twofold increase compared to the EBITDA of the same period last year.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for the quarter was INR74.9 crores, up 70.4% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: PAT for the quarter was INR74.9 crores, up 70.4% Y-o-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: Utilization level for the Ankleshwar unit during Q2 FY '27 was 30%.
orders_capacity.quote: Utilization level for Q2 FY '27 was 30%.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for the Sachin unit is 83%, Unit 2 at Ankleshwar is 23%, and Unit 3 Jhagadia is 55% for the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Okay. For the capacity utilization for the Sachin unit, the capacity is 83%. For Unit 2 at Ankleshwar, it is 23% and at Unit 3 Jhagadia, 55% for the quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash and cash equivalents were around Rs. 3,009 million as of 30th September 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash and cash equivalents were around Rs. 3,009 million as on 30th September 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital for the quarter stands at 115 days compared to 99 days in Q1 FY '27.
capital_allocation.quote: Our working capital for the quarter stands at 115 days vis-a-vis 99 days in Q1 FY '27.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash and cash equivalents were around INR314 crores as on 30th June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash and cash equivalents were around INR314 crores as on 30th June 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital for the quarter stands at 99 days versus 91 days in Q4 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Our working capital for the quarter stands at 99 days versus 91 days in Q4 FY '26.

risks_headwinds.claim: An acquisition of a U.S. customer caused a temporary pause in shipments for the BFC business.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the last quarter, our U.S. customer was acquired by another U.S.-based company. This caused a temporary pause in the shipment.

risks_headwinds.claim: The financial year began on a turbulent note, driven by geopolitical tensions in the Gulf.
risks_headwinds.quote: We began the financial year on a turbulent note, driven by geopolitical tensions in the Gulf.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to achieve Rs. 1,000 crores in CDMO revenue in FY '27.
management_commitments.quote: Based on the current orders of existing as well as new CDMO contracts, we now believe we will achieve this target one year ahead of schedule. It means in FY '27, we will be achieving this Rs. 1,000 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets doubling the CDMO business from Rs. 1,000 crores to a new target of Rs. 2,000 crores by FY 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Here, I would like to say that this CDMO business will be double in next 3 financial years. It means from Rs. 1,000 crores, the new target we had set is Rs. 2,000 crore by FY 2030.

management_commitments.claim: The Indichem plant capex is expected to get completed by the end of the current quarter.
management_commitments.quote: So this plant, we are happy to share that this is getting constructed even before the schedules and expected to get -- capex is expected to get completed by end of this quarter.

management_commitments.claim: Revenue from the Indichem plant is expected to come up from the next financial year onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And maybe from next financial year onwards, we will have the revenue coming up from that plant.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to complete its Phase 2 electrolyte additives capex by the end of Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And as we mentioned earlier also by end of Q2 FY '27, we would be completing our capex.

management_commitments.claim: Revenue from validated CDMO products is expected to kick in from H2 FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And with regulatory approval in place, we are expecting revenue to kick in from H2 FY '27 onwards.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
